narrative: Material PL1__M99D8D65 exhibits smooth demand (CV=0.225) with a statistically significant downward trend. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.201) with occasional spikes. The current SAP policy carries zero safety stock and uses only the MOQ as order quantity, resulting in ~408 orders/year and substantial ordering cost overrun. The recommended (r,Q) EOQ policy raises safety stock to 3,418 units to achieve the 95% service level and increases order quantity to the EOQ of 9,125 units, reducing orders to ~48/year and cutting total cost by 67.8%.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth demand regime (CV=0.225) with near-normal distribution and moderate lead-time variability is the canonical fit for a continuous-review (r,Q) policy. EOQ minimises total ordering plus holding cost; safety stock is derived from the combined demand-and-lead-time uncertainty formula at z=1.645 for 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity (30,337 units) is not binding: safety_stock + order_quantity = 12,543, leaving 17,794 units of headroom. No capacity-driven cost degradation.
